scope: Host-only existing IL, relocatable objects and linked ELF inspection. No emission, compiler/QBE invocation, guest execution, performance execution, or frozen-file edits.
limits: Static function bytes and relocation-site classification do not explain measured wall/cycle changes causally. Direct VM functions and declared glue are compared, not a dynamic opcode/path trace. Alignment/address changes may affect execution, but no causal attribution is made.
